label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Social Media Marketing
body: Social Media Marketing is the process of using social media platforms to connect with your audience, build your brand, and share your products or services.
caption:
Imagine you're a freelance graphic designer sharing your portfolio on LinkedIn or behind-the-scenes videos of your process on Instagram. That's social media marketing! It's a practical way to show off your skills, find new clients, and build a supportive community around your work. Start by choosing a platform where your ideal clients spend time and share what you do best.
